about.title: About Me
about.backgroundText1: Full-Stack Developer and Cybersecurity Analyst with over 2 years of experience in autonomous projects, developing Java systems with more than 1 million downloads in production. Currently studying Computer Science at UNESA and Cybersecurity at Centro Universitário FIAP.
about.backgroundText2: Focused on software architecture, performance, security, and API integration. Experience with Java and Spring Boot, using Redis, SQL, and AWS, applying best practices like Clean Code and principles of organization and scalability for building REST APIs.
about.philosophyText1: Autonomous - Software Developer with emphasis on Java (2023): Development and maintenance of large-scale Java applications with over 1 million downloads in production. Responsible for the complete development cycle, including implementation, testing, debugging, and bug fixing.
about.philosophyText2: Bungo Stray ERP - Full-Stack Developer focused on Back-end (2026): Development of a scalable multi-tenant ERP system using Java 17 and Spring Boot. JWT authentication with Spring Security, RBAC, and password hashing using BCrypt and Argon2id. Data persistence using Apache Cassandra and cache layer with Redis.
